app.name: Kitchen ordering
app.demoData: Demo data: stock and sales history are synthetic.

chat.title: Ask the agent
chat.label: What do you need? Several items or a new date are fine
chat.placeholder: e.g. 40 L cooking cream by Thursday
chat.working: Checking prices and delivery with Aimo…
chat.slow: Aimo is slow to answer. Still waiting…
chat.ex2: 5 kg butter and 10 L whipping cream by Friday
chat.empty: Tell the agent what you need. It finds the products, checks price and delivery with Aimo, and drafts a basket.
chat.newOrder: The price is confirmed and the basket is waiting for approval. Your next message starts a new order.

basket.title: Basket
basket.emptyHint: Ask the agent for what you need, or start from what is running low.
basket.notFound: This basket no longer exists. It may have been reset.
basket.addMore: Add another item from the chat or a running-low suggestion.
basket.deleteBody_one: The {{count}} line in it is removed. This cannot be undone.
basket.deleteBody_other: All {{count}} lines in it are removed. This cannot be undone.

action.draftHint: Prices are Aimo's current answer, not yet a commitment.
action.editVoids: Changing anything voids the signed price. You will need to confirm again.

policy.title: Extra check needed
policy.preview: Preview. Final once the price is signed.
policy.waitingHint: The signed price is saved. It is in Approvals for a {{role}} or above. The chat's next message starts a new order.
policy.yours: You can place this order yourself.

quote.expired: The signed price ran out at {{time}}
quote.expiredHint: Confirm again to get a fresh one. Prices may have changed.

outcome.orderedHint: Delivery {{date}}. Aimo's signed confirmation is saved.
outcome.adjusted: Aimo's answer changed. I updated the basket.
outcome.security: Order stopped: a signed document did not verify
outcome.securityHint: This has been logged as a security event.

suggest.title: Running low
suggest.noneHint: Stock and open orders cover the menu until {{until}}.

service.title: What did you cook today?
service.hint: One number per dish. The agent works out the ingredients used.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.emptyHint: Baskets appear here once Aimo has signed their price.

rules.title: Agent rules
rules.explain: Aimo enforces these limits on every order. The kitchen signs them.
rules.issueHint: Replaces the one in force from the next order.
rules.netHelp: Net goods value, without VAT and deposits.
rules.approvalLabel: A person must approve every order
rules.summary: You are about to sign: the agent may order up to {{order}} net per order and {{week}} net per week, for {{days}} days.
rules.summaryNoApproval: Orders inside these limits need no approval.
rules.errWeek: Lower than the per-order limit: one full order could never be placed.
rules.check1: Over the chef limit ({{chef}} net) a manager must approve; over the manager limit ({{manager}}) the owner must
rules.check2: Only part of a line can be delivered
rules.check3: The product differs from what was asked for
rules.check4: Pack size and price data disagree
rules.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change the agent's spending limits. Switch to Owner in the header to edit.
rules.managerLimit: Manager places and approves up to
rules.ownerLimit: Owner places and approves up to

activity.title: Activity
activity.noSteps: No steps yet. Ask the agent for something.
activity.aimoNote: Aimo sees product searches, price and delivery checks, signed prices and orders. It never sees recipes, portions sold, stock or forecasts.

demo.title: Demo controls
demo.note: Not part of the product. Clears baskets, orders, the mandate and the gateway's weekly spend.

error.network: Could not reach the kitchen service
error.networkHint: Check that it is running on port 8002. Nothing was ordered.
error.upstreamHint: The connection to Aimo dropped. Nothing was ordered and the basket is unchanged. Try again in a moment.

flag.differs_from_request: Not exactly what you asked for
flag.size_from_product_name: Pack size read from the name
flag.size_derived_from_price: Pack size worked out from the price
flag.size_disagrees_with_price: Pack size and price disagree: check

refusal.stock_changed: Stock changed since the price was signed
refusal.quote_already_used: This signed price was already used for an order
refusal.quote_invalid: The signed price did not verify
refusal.mandate_invalid: The mandate did not verify or has run out
refusal.category_not_allowed: A product group is outside the mandate

standing.title: Standing rules
standing.intro: What may go through without anyone looking. These are yours; Aimo never sees them.
standing.noneHint: Every order waits for a person until you set one.
standing.ceilingHint: Leave empty for no ceiling of its own. The signed mandate still applies.
standing.footnote: A rule can only relax an approval, never block one, and never clears a partial delivery, a substituted product or a pack size that disagrees with the price. A person still looks at those.
standing.ownerOnly: Only the owner can set or switch off standing rules.

audit.title: What happened, step by step
audit.none: Nothing recorded for this order yet.
audit.degraded: The database was unreachable, so these rows are from memory and are lost on restart.

role.label: Acting as
role.hint: No sign-in yet: choose who is using the screen.
